title: The finite point source uses the recorded tensor constraints
statement: For a finite-field datum D, prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, and n>=0, let S be a finite point tensor comparison [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-system]. Define its source-constraint condition by requiring that the finite-Tor inclusion [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] is strong monoidal into the recorded finiteIntrinsicClosed structure [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Its tensorator and unit map must be exactly the transports of S.tensor_eq and S.unit_eq. This fixes the ambient associator and unitors rather than allowing alternative source constraints.
